name: Unlogged Site Care Report
author: aac920

sections.description:
If you maintain WordPress sites for clients, your monthly work is mostly invisible: updates applied, content kept flowing, spam kept out. Unlogged Site Care Report makes that work visible — and helps justify your retainer.

From the moment you activate it, the plugin quietly logs:

  • WordPress core updates (with version numbers)
  • Plugin updates (name and new version)
  • Theme updates
  • Posts published
  • Comments approved

Then, any time you like, open Tools → Unlogged Site Care Report to see a clean monthly report — and email it to your client with one click. Or switch on automatic mode and the previous month’s report goes out by itself on the 1st of every month.

Why freelancers use it

  • Clients cancel retainers they cannot see the value of. A clear monthly report shows them that value without another meeting.
  • Zero configuration: activate, add the client’s email, done.
  • The email is clean, self-contained HTML that looks professional in every mail client.

Privacy

All data stays in your WordPress database. Nothing is sent to any external service. Uninstalling removes everything the plugin stored.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Tools → Unlogged Site Care Report.
  3. Add your client’s email and your business name, and optionally enable the automatic monthly email.
sections.faq:
Does it report activity from before activation?

No — logging starts at activation. After your first full month you’ll have a complete report.

Does it send my data anywhere?

No. Everything is stored in your own database and only leaves your site when you email a report to the address you configured.

Can I white-label the report?

The free version puts your business name in the footer. Full white-labeling (your logo and colors, no plugin branding) is planned for the Pro version.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Added a link to Perimeter (our free website security & accessibility checker) on the plugin’s settings page.

1.0.1

  • Fixed: the automatic monthly email could be skipped for a whole month if WP-Cron did not happen to run on the 1st. The report is now sent on the first scheduled run of each month, however late it lands.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: activity logging, monthly report page, one-click email, automatic monthly sending.
